paragraphs.text:
WE’VE CREATED A SPECIALIZED PRACTICE

Our mission is to provide extraordinary and personalized dental care to our patients, from infancy to adulthood. We are committed to providing care that centers on prevention, patient comfort and innovative, progressive technologies.
We submit to all insurance plans, and we also offer flexible in-house payment plans to ensure that cost of treatment does not stand in the way of appropriate care.

We provide Frenulum Evaluations for Ankyloglosia and Lip Tie related to breastfeeding in infants. We also have extensive experience with both anterior and posterior tongue ties, utilizing laser therapy for in‑office treatment options.

paragraphs.text: Your first visit at Oakland Smile Station begins with a warm welcome and a complete oral exam. We’ll take any necessary X-rays, review your dental history, and walk you through what to expect from diagnosis to next steps.

During the appointment we’ll create a personalized plan and go over treatment options, insurance, and payment choices. If you have questions beforehand, call (201) 337-6135 or email info@oaklandsmilestation.com.

paragraphs.text: Our traditional braces deliver reliable results for children and adults. Small brackets and wires apply precise pressure to move teeth into healthier alignment with consistent, monitored adjustments.

image.alt: Orthodontic team preparing braces for a patient

paragraphs.text: Clear, removable aligners use advanced 3D scanning to fit comfortably and move teeth with controlled precision. They let you eat, brush and floss normally while progressing toward your best smile.

image.alt: Close-up of clear aligner being held in a dental office

paragraphs.text: 3M Clarity aligners provide a discreet option with reliable tracking and a comfortable fit. They are a strong choice for patients seeking effective, less visible treatment.

image.alt: Dental team demonstrating clear aligner options

paragraphs.text: Lingual braces sit behind the teeth for an entirely hidden approach to orthodontics. They offer the control of traditional braces with the cosmetic benefit of being out of sight.

image.alt: Orthodontic treatment room with braces equipment

paragraphs.text: Early, interceptive care can guide jaw growth and prevent more complex problems later. Starting treatment at the right time may shorten or even eliminate the need for later braces.

image.alt: Pediatric dental team working with a young patient

paragraphs.text: Our pediatric team focuses on prevention and gentle care to build lifelong healthy habits. Services include routine exams, cleanings, fluoride, sealants and friendly behavior guidance for kids of all ages.

image.alt: Smiling child with pediatric dental team

paragraphs.text: We help anxious or returning patients feel comfortable while delivering restorative and preventive care. Services include cleanings, whitening, crowns, cosmetic options and personalized treatment plans to maintain lifelong oral health.

image.alt: Adult dental team smiling in modern clinic

paragraphs.text: Dental implants restore missing teeth with stable, long-term results. Our team coordinates implant planning and restoration to give you function and confidence.

paragraphs.text: Find answers to common questions about appointments, services, payments, and new patient steps at Oakland Smile Station.

accordion.header: What dental services do you provide?

paragraphs.text: We provide a full range of general dentistry services including cleanings, fillings, crowns, extractions, and cosmetic care. If you have a specific concern, call us and we’ll explain your options.

image.alt: Happy Family Portrait

accordion.header: How do I schedule an appointment?

paragraphs.text: Call us at (201) 337-6135 or send a message to info@oaklandsmilestation.com and our team will find a convenient time. We can also guide you through new patient paperwork before your visit.

image.alt: Couple Enjoying Time Together

accordion.header: Do you accept dental insurance and payment plans?

paragraphs.text: We accept most major dental insurance plans and offer flexible payment options. Our staff will verify your benefits and explain available payment choices before treatment begins.

image.alt: Collaborative Team Spirit Moment

accordion.header: What should I bring to my first visit?

paragraphs.text: Bring your photo ID, insurance card, and any recent dental records or x-rays. Arrive a few minutes early to complete new patient forms, or ask us about online forms to save time.

image.alt: Smiling Man Working at Desk

accordion.header: What if I have a dental emergency?

paragraphs.text: For urgent dental pain, a knocked-out tooth, or severe swelling call (201) 337-6135 immediately. We reserve same-day openings for emergencies and will advise you on next steps.
